description.en: The name of the OSS bucket.

description.zh: 是否开启向OSS投递模板执行记录功能，默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the delivery of template execution records to Object Storage Service (OSS). The default value is `false`.

description.zh: OSS存储空间目录，如"oos/execution",传入""表示不需要目录，若之前设置过再次设置不需要目录可通过传入""清空。
description.en: The key prefix of the OSS bucket. For example, `oos/execution`. To clear a previously configured prefix, set this parameter to an empty string (`""`).

description.zh: 是否开启向SLS投递模板执行记录功能，默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the delivery of template execution records to SLS. The default value is `false`.
The name of the Log Service (SLS) project.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos set-service-settings --delivery-oss-enabled false --delivery-oss-bucket-name OssBucketName --delivery-oss-key-prefix oos/execution --delivery-sls-project-name SlsProjectName --delivery-sls-enabled false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rdc-enterprise-id RdcEnterpriseId --service-access-rd-enabled true --rd-folder-ids rd-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos SetServiceSettings --region cn-hangzhou --DeliverySlsEnabled false --DeliveryOssKeyPrefix 'oos/execution' --DeliveryOssEnabled false --DeliveryOssBucketName OssBucketName --RdcEnterpriseId RdcEnterpriseId --ServiceAccessRdEnabled true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RdFolderIds '["rd-xxx"]' --DeliverySlsProjectName SlsProjectName
